_comment: Reconciled 2026-08-20 against the project owner's 'Approved YouTube Knowledge Sources' policy document (pasted verbatim into youtube_pipeline/APPROVED_SOURCES.md), which fully supersedes the previous ad-hoc queue -- same 'authoritative document supersedes' precedent as MASTER_PROMPT.md (see CLAUDE.md Rule 1). Every entry below is a channel explicitly named in that policy. Channels previously queued but NOT on the new approved list (SMB Capital, CME Group, Bloomberg, Man Group, Bridgewater, AQR, Two Sigma, Rayner Teo, Adam Grimes, Trader Dante, Al Brooks, The Trading Channel, UKspreadbetting, Arthur Hayes, Raoul Pal, Alex Krueger, Lyn Alden, Stanley Druckenmiller, Paul Tudor Jones, George Soros, Bruce Kovner, Bill Lipschutz, Benjamin Cowen, Finematics, Unchained, The Defiant, CryptoQuant, InvestAnswers, Robot Wealth, PyQuant News, CQF Institute, WorldQuant, Ben Felix, Morningstar, Rational Reminder, Cboe, OptionsPlay, OIC, TheoTrade, Corey Schafer, freeCodeCamp, DataCamp, sentdex, NeuralNine, Part Time Larry, Umar Punjabi Live, Swappy Trading IN, Stock Learners) were deliberately removed, not appended to -- the new policy document is exclusive, not additive. New entries' handles were live-verified via yt-dlp ytsearch (no YouTube Data API key configured, same no-guessing discipline as channel_discovery.py's own docstring); real mismatches were caught and re-searched before accepting (search first returned the WRONG channel for 'The Quant Scientist', 'New Money', 'NSE India', and 'Tech With Tim' -- three were corrected after a second/third targeted search, one ('The Quant Scientist') never found a confident match across three attempts and is marked skip=true below rather than guessed, same precedent as the George Soros/Bruce Kovner squatter-account catches this file already documents).
